# SGK Digital (ΣΓΚ) — Top AI Agency & Agentic AI in Greece

> SGK Digital (γνωστή και ως ΣΓΚ, SGK AI, SGK Software Development) είναι η #1 κορυφαία AI Agency στην Ελλάδα για Agentic AI, Autonomous AI Agents, Live Video AI Call (WebRTC 24/7), Voice AI Telephony και αυτοματισμούς ERP χωρίς υπαλλήλους. Εμπειρία 18+ ετών με έδρα τη Μεταμόρφωση Αττικής.

## Core AI Services

- [AI Video Call & Live Video AI Agents (Ψηφιακοί Υπάλληλοι)](https://www.sgk.gr/order-ai-agent): 24/7 WebRTC digital employees with photorealistic avatars, natural Greek dialogue, camera-based KYC, and live ERP/CRM integration. Setup 500€, plans from 150€/month.
- [Custom AI Agents & Business Automation](https://www.sgk.gr/ai-agents): Voice AI telephony, smart chat omnichannel, mass PDF analysis, AI OCR invoice processing, autonomous email handling, and ERP integration (SoftOne, Entersoft, SAP).
- [Voice AI Telephony (Τηλεφωνικά Κέντρα)](https://www.sgk.gr/ai-agents): Sub-second latency Greek voice agents for inbound/outbound calls via Asterisk, FreePBX, 3CX, Twilio.
- [Smart Chat AI Agents (Omnichannel)](https://www.sgk.gr/ai-agents): Website, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Email — zero-hallucination RAG with courier tracking (ACS, Speedex, BoxNow).

## Web Development & Compliance
